column1: # Merge-disposition cases, shared by two implementations of one rule set:
#   scripts/test/test-classify-change.sh   -> scripts/classify-change.sh
#   software-factory MergeDispositionTest  -> codereview/domain/MergeDisposition.java
# The factory arms auto-merge from the Java copy; the pr-review-loop skill and humans run
# the bash one. Both must answer identically, and this file is the only thing that makes
# them: add a case here and both test suites run it.
# Format: one case per line, TAB-separated.
#   description <TAB> category <TAB> ux_affecting <TAB> space-separated paths (may be empty)
# A line starting with '#!' is a group heading; any other '#' line is a comment.
#! rule 3 — cannot change a shipped pixel or production infrastructure
backend source is auto-merge
software-factory plus docs is auto-merge
frontend unit tests ship no pixel
frontend e2e tests ship no pixel
root markdown is auto-merge
a spec directory is auto-merge
#! rule 2 — a visitor can see it
frontend application source needs visual review
public assets need visual review
the entry document needs visual review
#! rule 1 — needs a human
vite config changes the shipped bundle
frontend dependencies change the shipped bundle
the production compose file is infrastructure
scripts are infrastructure
workflows are infrastructure
nginx config is infrastructure
the gradle wrapper is infrastructure
a config file nested under frontend still matches the bundle rule
#! precedence
# The one that protects production: an auto-merge to main triggers Publish, which
# triggers an unattended infrastructure deploy against the Pi.
rule 1 beats rule 3 — backend plus compose is manual
rule 2 beats rule 3 — backend plus frontend source needs visual review
rule 1 beats rule 2 — frontend source plus a script is manual
order does not matter: the script first
#! rule 4 — the default-deny that stops a new directory inheriting merge rights
an unrecognised top-level directory is manual
one unrecognised path is enough to demand a human
an unrecognised root file is manual
nested markdown outside a known directory is manual
an empty change arms nothing
